intent_snapshot.goal: Build a versioned reviewer eval corpus from committed audit records: eligible historical review cases with revision identity, finding anchor and evidence, acceptance text, and disposition, where resolved counts only as a silver label, gold labels are human-confirmed, clean cases are included, and the newest cases form a holdout validation split. Gold-case selection uses a pre-screen built on the shared decision-model decide() at a newly registered A1 application point, with a committed project egress ceiling that admits only finding to clef.

acceptance.assertion: Meet S0 in docs/specs/review-verifier-eval.spec.md: an offline extractor run at a pinned commit yields a deterministic corpus (same input commit produces byte-identical corpus.jsonl); a case enters the gold pool only under the eligibility rule of Spec S0 item 1, and ineligible records are excluded with counts by reason; the corpus validates against its schema and separates disposition (silver label) from gold (confirmed_true / confirmed_false / unlabeled) as distinct fields; the README states in its first paragraph that resolved is a silver label only and documents the gold labelling protocol (first set: 30 cases labelled by Derek, at least 10 confirmed_false or clean); at least 10 clean revisions from done tasks with no request_rework are included; the split is by task recency with the newest 20 percent held out as the validation split and is stable across regeneration. Selection of the 30 gold cases is uncertainty-first under an offline pre-screen (scripts/review-eval/prescreen.ts) that calls the shared decide() at application point a1_review_finding_prescreen with each extracted finding's trigger, caller_chain, and violated fields: least-confident cases and cases whose lean disagrees with the silver disposition are labelled first, and the item 3 weight rule breaks remaining ties. The classifier output is recorded only in a selection log carrying the per-candidate fields of Spec S0 item 7, including the path used (model or weight_rule), and never becomes a label or corpus gold. Disabling the pre-screen, and every unavailable decide() result named in Spec S0 item 7, each reproduce the weight-rule selection exactly with the log naming weight_rule for every affected candidate. The selection log and README contain no credential or environment-variable value.

The code-owned registry (plugins/immune-brain/runtime/decision_model/thresholds.ts) registers a1_review_finding_prescreen with input_category finding, options likely_true, likely_false, uncertain, and threshold set a1/v0 with values null; the committed project config .imm/config.json declares decision_models.egress.clef = ["finding"] and no other egress kind or category, so resolving the repository's effective configuration with a user egress request of clef/finding yields effective egress clef = ["finding"] and every other provider kind empty, while a user request of clef/diff is dropped with egress_beyond_project_ceiling.

The S0 extractor (Spec S0 item 1) treats a git object as eligible when it exists as a commit in the local object store at extraction time, so a case whose base_head and review_commit are unreachable from HEAD and from every ref still enters the gold pool, while a case with a missing object is excluded with reason git_object_missing. The extractor pins every commit an emitted case references at refs/imm/review-eval/<sha>; rerunning it is idempotent and leaves corpus.jsonl byte-identical whether or not the pins already exist, an existing pin under that name pointing at another object stops the run without writing a corpus, and the extractor never pushes a ref.

attestations.summary: 未发现本轮阻断问题；packet、manifest 摘要和 Git revision 身份均已验证。extract.ts:92-98 按每个 task 的最新时间确定 holdout，新增测试覆盖 audit 路径顺序与时间顺序相反的情况。影响范围 tier low，本轮承重路径为 scripts/review-eval/extract.ts 和 tests/review-eval-corpus.test.ts；其他变更沿用前轮覆盖，测试执行采用 manifest 中 Kernel QA 的通过证据，未重跑测试。

findings.summary: scripts/review-eval/extract.ts:108–114 未区分缺失 ref 与 dangling symbolic ref；update-ref 默认解引用，可使 pin 创建写入 refs/imm/review-eval/ 之外的用户 ref。应拒绝 symbolic pin，并让事务禁止解引用；补充回归测试，断言目标 ref 和 corpus 均不改变。

evidence.trigger: 本地 refs/imm/review-eval/<sha> 已是指向尚不存在的 refs/heads/user-new 的 symbolic ref，且 <sha> 被 emitted case 引用 → rev-parse --verify --quiet 返回 1，pinCommits 将它当作缺失 pin，随后 update-ref 的 create 默认解引用并创建 refs/heads/user-new；提取器继续写出 corpus，同时产生 pin 命名空间之外的未授权分支写入。

violated.ref: extractor pin writes confined to refs/imm/review-eval/

findings.summary: scripts/review-eval/extract.ts:92–95 按遍历顺序覆盖同一 task_id 的时间，而非取该任务最新时间；多个历史 run 会使 holdout 选错任务。应按 task_id 聚合最大 task_time，并在 tests/review-eval-corpus.test.ts 增加同一任务多个 run、路径顺序与时间顺序相反的用例，断言最新任务进入 validation。现有 :106–112 只检查同任务 split 一致，无法保护 recency 要求。

evidence.trigger: 命名输入 commit 包含任务 T 的两个 eligible audit run：路径排序靠前的 run 时间为 2026-03-01，靠后的 run 时间为 2026-01-01；另有任务 U 时间为 2026-02-01，且两个任务均引用存在的 commit → Map 最后写入将 T 的时间降为一月，两个任务中唯一的 validation 名额分给 U，最新任务 T 的所有案例反而进入 tuning，违反 newest 20 percent holdout。
